title: pyrus × pulcherrima var. scheideckeri
intro: Pyrus × pulcherrima var. scheideckeri, commonly known as Christmas Box or Pyrus Scheideckeri, is a hybrid plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is known for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Bioactive constituents of Pyrus × pulcherrima var. scheideckeri include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
